mapping.ARVectorPush: CRC driver::push_ring appends one complete RingEntry then drains oldest excess; reachable pre-length<=1024 means at most one removed.
mapping.ARDequePush: AppliedRing::push pops front exactly when len==1024, then pushes the owned receipt to back.
mapping.ARCertificate: strictly_increasing &= previous_back.is_none_or(last.index < entry.index), evaluated before eviction; once false it remains false.
mapping.ARLookup: AppliedRing::find_index chooses binary_search_by_key only with checked strict certificate, otherwise the original iterator first match.
mapping.ARLookupRefinement: Same found/absent value and full index/term/outcome payload for every query; downstream inspect_applied term equality/exclusive outcome discrimination remains unchanged.
mapping.ARRefinement: Logical sequence equality also preserves len/front/back used by eviction classification.

standard_library_boundary.trusted: For a sorted deque binary_search_by_key returns a matching position iff present; among duplicates any matching position is allowed. Vec/VecDeque logical sequence operations, integer comparison, allocation/compiler and mutex implementation are not verified here.
standard_library_boundary.invalid_input: No sorted-search postcondition is claimed when unsorted. The proof establishes the certificate implies strict ordering before using that contract.
standard_library_boundary.ARAny_scope: A logical CHOOSE representative under uniqueness, not an executable binary-search model; TLC deterministic choice is not evidence for arbitrary malformed-search behavior.

input_scope: Every positive capacity and legal domain, arbitrary incoming indexes including duplicates/decreases/gaps/extremes; instantiate ARIndexes with the full u64 index domain to cover absent queries as well. Terms and exclusive outcomes are opaque payloads. No producer ordering or success-only restriction.
composition_scope: Serialized ring operations with the unchanged caller locking/inspection code. No claim of machine-checked Rust extraction, whole-driver/Raft/Ready composition, liveness, cancellation, allocator/OOM or crash-storage correctness.
